summary: Iter 92.5 FINAL PUSH — GREEN. All 4 premium features verified end-to-end. Backend 14/14 pytest GREEN: (1) GDPR Unsubscribe full lifecycle works — bad token → 400 'Ungültiger oder abgelaufener Link', valid HMAC token → 200 with email/category_label/already_unsubscribed; POST /confirm flips flag (already_unsubscribed:true on re-info), /resubscribe flips back (already_unsubscribed:false); (2) /api/lifecycle/status returns video_drip_weeks=[1,2,3,4,5,6]; (3) POST /api/cron/video-drip runs idempotent (0 sent due to missing vimeo_id, no 500s); (4) /api/ab/assign/fake_wlad_call_bribe returns enrolled:true with variant in (control|bribe); /api/ab/event accepts impression event ok:true; (5) Payments WLAD10 = 897.30€, no-code = 997.00€, invalid-code = 997.00€ (graceful); (6) /favicon.svg HTTP 200 + image/svg+xml, /icon-192.png + /apple-touch-icon.png HTTP 200. Frontend Playwright GREEN: WladMark new geometry verified on /login — `.wlad-mark-animated` class present, exact path `M2.8 4.8 L8.6 24.4 Q10 25.8 11.4 24.2 L15.4 9.8 Q16.4 8.8 17.4 9.8 L20.8 24.2 Q22.2 25.8 23.6 24.4 L28.8 4` (has both L linear + Q quadratic Bézier curves at valleys, matches spec exactly). Login test@test.com/test123 → /dashboard works. /email/unsubscribe (no token + garbage.token) → premium dark fallback with 'Hmm, das hat nicht geklappt.' + 'LINK UNGÜLTIG' badge + data-testid='unsubscribe-back-home' button visible. Dashboard loads error-free. MyPath → Lernvideos shows exactly 6 'Gratis'-Videos (Iter 92.3 not regressed). Zero pageerrors during normal flow.

ui_bugs.component: WladMark on /login brand panel & dashboard sidebar
ui_bugs.issue: `data-testid="brand-wordmark"` is defined on the WladWordmark React component (WladMark.js:152) but the /login and /dashboard sidebar render the mark via a different (custom) brand panel that does not expose this testid. The mark itself is visually rendered with .wlad-mark-animated + .wlad-mark-w (correct geometry).

action_items: (Optional) Expose data-testid='brand-wordmark' on the /login + sidebar brand panels so QA can deterministically locate the wordmark (currently only present on the WladWordmark button component, which is not used in those positions).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/unsubscribe.py — Clean HMAC stateless implementation; signing key reuses JWT_SECRET (good — no extra secret to manage), 365-day TTL, base64url + JSON payload, hmac.compare_digest for timing-safe verification. CATEGORIES + CATEGORY_LABELS mapping centralised. unsubscribe_url() helper is the right abstraction for embedding in email templates. Idempotent: resubscribe before confirm and re-running confirm twice both behave correctly.

EmailUnsubscribePage — Error fallback design is consistent with brand (dark premium, WladMark, badge, CTA back to dashboard). data-testid='unsubscribe-back-home' present on error path. Token-missing + malformed-token both route to the same error phase. Good.

WladMark.js — NEW path geometry is clean: linear (L) segments for the legs + quadratic Bézier (Q) for the valley curves + signature flick + crown pixel-dot. .wlad-mark-animated triggers idle-sway + scan-line shimmer. Drop-shadow ghost path gives float depth without extra DOM nodes. Asymmetric end-flick differentiates from generic W glyphs.
AppErrorBoundary wrapping App.js is the right place (outermost). Note: not directly testable without forcing a render crash — verified via 'no pageerror events' during normal flow.
(Pre-existing minor) /api/payments/checkout requires `origin_url` in body — already documented in the route schema; the test was initially missing it (fixed in test).
test_credentials: test@test.com / test123 (works; user_id user_f111693f1b00 verified via HMAC token roundtrip with backend's JWT_SECRET)
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded test user. State touched: users.unsubscribed_video_drip flag (toggled true → false during lifecycle test, ends in false/resubscribed state). One row written to email_unsubscribes collection per confirm call.
